thread:
leo: Quick announcement: On-Prem Agent v2.1.1 is scheduled for staged rollout on 2026-04-09. This patch focuses on two customer-facing items: 1) per-tenant signed compliance bundles with build metadata, 2) an easier telemetry opt-out flow for regulated deployments. No app downtime expected; agent process will restart.

leo: Short paste-for-customer message:
- Upgrade window: 2026-04-09 (staged)
- Preflight: `./agent preflight --full`
- Evidence artifacts will appear at tenant S3 prefix after upgrade
- Telemetry: installers can pass `--telemetry=opt-out` or toggle in console

ana_se: Can we confirm whether the signed bundles include the OS package hashes? Some customers require SHA512 checksums for each binary.

compliance: Yes, bundles include binary SHA512, build id, signer key id, and a mapping CSV that ties artifacts to SOC/ISO controls. We also include a short human-readable summary for auditors.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout plan created: onprem-agent/v2.1.1 -> canary (5 hosts) -> regional. Canary start: 2026-04-09T10:00:00Z. CI: https://ci.internal/release/823

legal: Please ensure signed bundle contains timestamp and signer certificate chain. We'll attach an audit request template in the release notes.

leo: Noted. We'll include timestamp and certificate chain in `signed_manifest.txt`.

ana_se: Telemetry default retention for this build? Need blurb for customer comms.

leo: Defaults: metrics 30 days, lightweight logs 7 days. `--telemetry=opt-out` disables remote export and retains local metrics for 0 days by default unless the customer configures local retention. Air-gapped installs default to local-only telemetry.

cto_jen: Pair compliance + SE for the initial 10 pilot customers. If any look like they'll need longer windows, we hold.

compliance: We'll coordinate with CS and provide per-tenant evidence packs on request.

leo: Final release notes will be posted by EOD Thu. If you need custom signing key inclusion or different retention settings for a customer, open a support ticket and tag #announcements. :white_check_mark:
